test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In February 2023, UNICEF India announced the appointment of which celebrated Bollywood star as a National Ambassador for Child Rights?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ayushmann Khurrana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ayushmann Khurrana**, a celebrated Bollywood actor, was appointed as the **National Ambassador for Child Rights** by **UNICEF India** in **February 2023**.
 
• The role of a **National Ambassador** involves advocating for the rights and well-being of children, raising awareness about critical issues affecting children, and supporting initiatives aimed at improving their lives.
 
• **Ayushmann Khurrana** is known for his socially relevant films and has been actively involved in spreading awareness about various social issues, making him a fitting choice for this position.
 
• As a National Ambassador, he will contribute to addressing issues such as **education, health, protection, and equitable opportunities** for children.
 
• **UNICEF**, or the **United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund**, is a global organization working in over 190 countries to protect the rights of children and ensure their survival, education, and development.
 
• This appointment aligns with **UNICEF's mission** to leverage influential personalities to amplify messages about child rights and engage the public effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pankaj Tripathi**__

 __
 
• **Pankaj Tripathi** is a highly regarded Bollywood actor known for his versatile roles in films and web series.
 
• While he is not associated with UNICEF in this capacity, his work often highlights social and cultural issues, resonating with audiences across India.
 
 
 
• **Aamir Khan**__
 __
 
• **Aamir Khan** is a prominent Bollywood actor and filmmaker, known for his dedication to social causes.
 
• He has been associated with various initiatives like **Satyamev Jayate**, which addresses issues such as child rights, health, and education.
 
 
 
• **Pankaj Kapoor**__
 
 
• **Pankaj Kapoor** is a veteran actor in Indian cinema and theater, renowned for his performances in critically acclaimed films and TV shows.
 
• He is not known for any specific association with **UNICEF** or child rights advocacy.
